events.title: Little Monsters
events.description: Little Monsters is a ticketed event. A ticket must be bought for each adult and child attending. Each $10 ticket comes with a bag of 20 Netherworld tokens to be used during the session. Extra tokens can be purchased as normal. These sessions are suitable for small family groups with children 12 years and under. We’re often asked “Can I bring my tiny terror?” Our underworld policy is that because it can get a little gnarlier as the evening goes on, we don’t allow little ones after 5pm. There’s creatures stuck in the wall that’ll swallow them whole if you’re not careful. To even that out, we host ‘Little Monsters’ from 9.30am to 11.30am – a morning for guardians and monsters to be. The bar will be stocked up with soda, juice and something with less sugar because we’re not all monsters.Please note Netherworld will be closed between 11.30am and Midday. A Little Monsters FAQ Unfortunately during these sessions we cannot cater to large gatherings or parties, as the sessions are more focused on providing a more relaxed space outside of our regular hours for families to enjoy the games together. We don’t do any table bookings during these session – it’s very casual. The session runs from 9.30am to 11.30am, with a 15 minute heads up at 11.15am. We require the venue to be vacated at this time so that we can clean up and refresh the venue for our lunchtime open at midday.No outside food or drink is allowed. If your child has any dietry needs during this time that requires you bring your own food, this is of course perfectly fine. If you have any questions whatsoever, get in touch via info@netherworldarcade.com.

events.title: CULT-LUCHA: Santo and Blue Demon vs. the Monsters / Santo y Blue Demon Contra Los Monstruos (1969)
events.description: Join us for CULT-LUCHA: Mexican Wrestling Monster Movie Madness! A monthly Sunday movie night in the Netherworld hosted by Brisbane Schlock-Film luminary Andrew Leavold (Trash Video) and local Lucha Libre artist and wrestling fanatic Chris Bryan. This incredibly strange and wonderful tag-team duo will enter the ring for a journey through the history of classic Mexican wrestling films. The monthly event will include an intro by the hosts, merch desk and cult screening in the arcade room of the Netherworld. This month’s iconic Lucha film classic is Santo and Blue Demon vs. the Monsters / Santo y Blue Demon Contra Los Monstruos (1969) It kicks off at 7pm and is free to join in. trashvideoarchives.com // @trashvideoarchives www.christhings.com.au // @christhings

events.title: Trash MTG – Pauper Commander
events.description: What the hell is Trash MTG!? It’s a Magic The Gathering event dual hosted by Netherworld and Vault Games,but you only get to use your junky cheap cards. Commander with all commons in the 99. We want you to MINE YOUR CARDS you’d otherwise ignore. The ones sitting in shoe boxes at the bottom of a cupboard, potentially never to see the light of day again…until now. If you don’t have quite enough cards to put something together, we’ll have a collection of 10,000 cards on site you can dig into to trade in and out of. Pauper Commander follows the normal Commander rules except… your Commander is an uncommon, and the rest of the 99 are commons. Health is a hair lower at 30 and commander damage is 16. In the spirit of ‘Trash MTG’ and an encouragement to use what you have instead of riding the meta wave, we’ll have a house rule that regardless of the history of the card, all common cards included must be common according to the card. If you haven’t played Commander before, the Vault Games and Netherworld crew are happy to teach you and will even have a handful of house decks on hand you can utilise if you don’t have the trash resources to pull a deck together. If you’re after any Magic sealed products, make sure you swing over to Vault Games CBD, Clayfield or online via vaultgames.com.au ! Each ticket comes with your first drink and a custom token card. It happens at 6.30 to 10pm. Tickets to the next Netherworld session can be grabbed via www.netherworldarcade.com/events and Vault Games sessions via www.vaultgames.com.au !

events.title: Brisbane Pinball Club
events.description: Every fortnight, the Brisbane Pinball Club meets in the Netherworld. Each meeting will require you to play 10 different pinball machines of the club’s choosing at your own pace. If you’ve ever wanted to join a Pinball club, this is your time to shine! It’s open to absolutely everybody and all skill levels. Prizes awarded to the top 8 places and playing will get you an International Flipper Pinball Association (IFPA) ranking. Head down anytime from 3pm to 7pm to get involved, with finals happening from 8.30pm! Entry is $20 with early bird entry of $15 if you make it down by 4pm.

events.title: Horrid Little Things
events.description: Join us for HORRID LITTLE THINGS, a monthly event where we make nasty tiny creatures with polymer clay, bake ‘em and give them a fresh coat of gunky paint. It happens over a couple of the rooms in Lost Souls with a host and includes all materials needed along with your first drink. It happens from 6pm until 10pm monthly. Time it right and you’ll grab a Hellmouth Diner meal while your critter is frying in the oven. Tickets are limited to 16 persons and can be grabbed below!

events.title: Acolytes of the Blade – Beyblade X Pit Fights
events.description: Behind closed doors, shrouded in secrecy, the acolytes hone their skills mastering a VERY specific art of fighting. For while you were partying, they studied the Beyblade. BYOB (bring yer own blades) for a Beyblade X 3on3 deck format. Each player uses a deck of 3 Beyblades with no repeating parts. If you’re new to the extreme sport and want give it a go, new acolytes are very welcome – no knowledge necessary and loaner blades are on hand to show you how to pit fight. Acolytes of the Blade happens monthly on a Wednesday at 6.30pm in the Lost Souls area of Netherworld. $10 registration on arrival, with a killer door prize on the line. Under 18 participants are welcome, though MUST be accompanied by their legal guardian.

events.title: Netherworld Trivia
events.description: Netherworld’s weekly Trivia! Focusing on general pop culture, you’ve got to be current and not-so-current on your movie, television, games and weird event knowledge. Prizes for the top 3 teams and enamel pins for the winning team! It happens every Wednesday in the Netherworld at 6.30pm sharp. Registration is necessary and tables are seated on a first in best dressed basis. Registration opens the Thursday beforehand and you can sign up via trivia.netherworldarcade.com.

events.title: Monster Life Drawing
events.description: **Tickets will be on sale at midday on Friday the 28th of August on this page. Join us for Monster Life Drawing in Netherworld’s Lost Souls Bar! In conjunction with Fortitude Valley SFX queen Megan Farquharson Makeup Artist (IG @_mf_fx), we’re digging into a night of illustrations with a twist. We’ll provide you with the materials for a handful of still life and life drawing setups, but in the way you’d expect from the Netherworld. You’ll be presented with fantasy, horror and sci fi inspired models in costume and SFX makeup, alongside creatures and items from the depths of the Netherworld. Each ticket comes with your first drink, the materials and an evening of illustration guided by a host. This session happens on Thursday the 24th of September at 6.30pm – grab a spot below!

events.title: Belles & Chimes Flip Frenzy
events.description: Spinning off from our monthly Belles & Chimes Women’s Pinball Meetup is a new monthly Belles Flip Frenzy happening throughout the year! A morning of manic head to head pinball for women and non-binary persons. Over the course of roughly 3 hours, you’ll be pitted against a variety of opponents on a large selection of pinball machines. Win or lose then move game and opponent. Expect to play around 20 games each with the player with the most wins at the end of the whirlwind competition taking top place. Top 8 will then compete in a double elimination bracelet final. Doors open at 8am with all games on free play for warm up. There’ll be a rules rundown at 8:45 with the comp starting at 9am sharp. Tickets includes entry to the comp and your first drink. Grab them via www.netherworldarcade.com !
